HIRING FOR ONE OF THE MOST PRESTIGIOUS MNC's.....





Job Title: Python Developer with Generative AI


Experience: 6-10 Years


Location: Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune





Job Description:




We are seeking a highly skilled Python Developer with Generative AI experience to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python development, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI frameworks, and cloud-based AI solutions.





Key Responsibilities:



Design and develop scalable applications using Python and Generative AI technologies.
Build and integrate AI/ML models, including Large Language Models (LLMs), into enterprise applications.
Develop intelligent chatbots, virtual assistants, RAG-based solutions, and AI automation workflows.
Work with frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, and OpenAI APIs.
Implement prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and optimization techniques.
Design and manage vector databases for semantic search and retrieval systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver AI-driven solutions.
Develop REST APIs and microservices for AI applications.
Ensure application performance, scalability, security, and reliability.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in Generative AI and machine learning technologies.




Required Skills:



Strong proficiency in Python programming.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and AI application development.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, OpenAI, or similar AI frameworks.
Knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures and vector databases such as Pinecone, Chroma, FAISS, or Weaviate.
Experience in API development using FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Understanding of machine learning concepts and model deployment.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.




Preferred Qualifications:



Experience in NLP, deep learning, and AI model fine-tuning.
Exposure to MLOps and AI deployment pipelines.
Relevant certifications in AI, Machine Learning, or Cloud technologies are a plus.
